responsibility: Provides the RTL machine description for the RISC-V vector extension itself. Building on vector-iterators.md, it defines RVV-specific attributes for VL/VTYPE dependence and encoding properties, along with the instruction patterns for predicated vector loads/stores, arithmetic, comparisons, reductions, moves, permutations, fault-only-first loads, CSR reads, and other vector operations that are later coordinated by the vsetvl pass and RVV builtin expanders.
